dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp white-to-cream linear edges along the folded primary and secondary feathers, creating high contrast against dark brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible transition from fine, uniform tawny-brown feathers on the crown to the larger, dark-centered, pale-fringed scalloped feathers of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark-pigmented facial mask covering the ocular and auricular regions, contrasting with the lighter brown crown.
